source: Server log /home/codespace/.local/share/opencode/log/opencode.log (ref err_c80ad634, err_95f43c8c) plus direct inspection of /home/codespace/.config/opencode/plugins/auto-capture.js, 2026-10-08

entities.name: auto-capture plugin
entities.description: Plugin at ~/.config/opencode/plugins/auto-capture.js, the only file in the scanned plugin directory. Default-exports {id, setup} and registers chat.message and event hooks that turn user messages into knowledge-graph candidate drafts

entities.name: OpenCode v2 plugin API
entities.description: A plugin module must default-export an object carrying an id plus an effect or setup function. Default-exporting a bare async function fails schema validation with SchemaError: Expected object at [default], surfaced as a server-side 'failed to load plugin' warning and a silent no-op - no hooks are registered and the plugin never runs

entities.name: OpenCode plugin directory
entities.description: ~/.config/opencode/plugins/ - the only directory scanned for plugins at server start. Plugins elsewhere, such as /workspaces/opencode-config/plugin/, are never loaded

entities.name: auto-capture plugin format failure
entities.description: 2026-10-08 11:19-11:20, server refused to load auto-capture.js (ref err_c80ad634) because it default-exported a bare async function. Fixed at 11:26 by a two-step migration to { id: 'auto-capture', setup: async ({directory}) => hooks }. A watcher reload at 11:26:26 caught the file mid-write and failed with a different error (ref err_95f43c8c, AggregateError building the module) - that was a truncated-write artifact, not a second defect. Verified fixed: 'loading plugin' entries with no following failure at 13:45, 14:10 and 2026-10-09 00:22
